_comment: Copy to env.json and fill in. Pass with --dart-define-from-file=env.json on every flutter run/build. env.json is gitignored; this file is the checked-in key list.
_comment_supabase: Must be the SAME project the API validates against. The server hands your token to its own Supabase, so a token from a different project is simply invalid there and every route 401s. Local stack: run `supabase start` in pokepedia-web. From a physical device use the machine's LAN address, not 127.0.0.1 — that is the phone itself.
_comment_api: The pokepedia-web deployment the app calls for routes needing a server secret (checkout, shipping rates, scan). Production must be the www host: the apex 308s every request, and Dart's HttpClient only auto-follows redirects for GET/HEAD, so a POST to the apex returns the redirect body instead of the route's.
_comment_google: Google's web OAuth client id, as configured in Supabase under Authentication > Providers > Google. Native sign-in sends it as serverClientId and Supabase checks the ID token's audience against it, so the two must match. The iOS id identifies the app itself; Android uses package name + signing fingerprint and needs none.
